steps.name: Login CMS with email: customer@example.com and password: 123456

Navigate to Home page
Open URL https://cms.anhtester.com
Click close I Understood
Click on element By.xpath: //button[normalize-space()='Ok. I Understood']
Click close popup

Click on element By.xpath: //a[text()='Login']

Click on element By.xpath: //button[normalize-space()='Login']
Search and Navigate to Product Page: Coca cola
